NVIDIA (NVDA) vs Intel (INTC): on the same formula, their operating margins are 64.6 pts apart. What does that gap explain, and what doesn’t it?

Latest fiscal year, same formula
• Revenue — NVDA: $215.9B · INTC: $52.9B
• Revenue growth — NVDA: +65.5% · INTC: −0.5%
• Operating margin — NVDA: 60.4% · INTC: −4.2%
• Net margin — NVDA: 55.6% · INTC: −0.5%
• Free cash flow margin — NVDA: 44.8% · INTC: −9.4%
• 4-year revenue growth (compound annual) — NVDA: 68.3% · INTC: −9.6%

Different fiscal years: NVDA Jan 25, 2026 · INTC Dec 27, 2025. The periods are not identical.
